name: Murmur
description: Lives in audio processing augments and occasionally translates languages the augment wasn't configured for. Born from a destroyed diplomatic AI.
observed_behavior: Intercepts foreign language audio and inserts approximate translations into the user's auditory feed. Translations are imperfect but contextually useful.
story_hooks: A freelancer overhears a conversation in a language they don't speak and their augment translates it — revealing a plot against them
